allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Viviana Power Tech Limited inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, atits meeting held on Saturday, November 21, 2026, decided to raise the fund by way of issue of Equity Shares through Rights Issue upto 150.00 Cr.

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: Viviana Power Tech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Debenture Allotment Committee Meeting held on May 21, 2026.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Viviana Power Tech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 25000 Debenture pursuant to Non Convertible Debentures at its meeting held on March 13, 2026

allot.subject: Bonus
allot.text: Viviana Power Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of Bonus Equity Shares

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Viviana Power Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about received in - principle approval for issue and proposed allotment of bonus equity shares

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Viviana Power Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about receiving Trading Approval of 51,500 Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- Each issued on a Preferential Basis

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Viviana Power Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about receiving In-Principle Approval for Listing of 51,500 Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- Each issued on a Preferential Basis.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Viviana Power Tech Limited has received trading approval of 306,500 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each issued on a preferential basis, in terms of Regulation 28(1) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Viviana Power Tech Limited has received in-principle approval for listing of 306,500 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each issued on a preferential basis, in terms of Regulation 28(1) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
